header: RAM word 0x348E (v9 0x348E, v7 0x33F2): the SYSTEM_TIMESTAMP value of the last TAP TEMPO press -- AccProcess_InlinedCode stores it on every press and takes the next interval from it, AccProcess_TimerCompare ends the tap sequence 0x400 ticks after it. It is no pattern selector: its only four uses are these word loads / stores. Basis: readers.
